checks: Three originals: correct total price, one atomic call, aggregate ETH ceiling and persisted request count
Default 1000 PROTO approval followed by a fresh balance and batch review; only one opening transaction
Actual review hook exposes current PROTO balance, 1000 default or exact larger approval, existing allowance and finite gas without sending
insufficient: no approval or opening sent
soldout: no approval or opening sent
Legacy implementation keeps single purchases operational and cannot send unsupported batch calls
Maximum ten, multi-card demo selection, and mobile layout
Exact-price permits for one and three packs require signature then explicit gas review; one engine transaction, immutable deadline and ordinary saved request grouping
Separate approval remains an explicit freshly reviewed 1000 PROTO alternative without signing or sending automatically
Known old engines, unsupported capability or token domain use separate approval; an existing sufficient allowance keeps the direct purchase
Rejected or wrong-wallet signatures, wallet/chain switches, expired/replayed permissions and failed full-call simulation never send or trigger automatic approval
Nonce drift without sufficient allowance and expiry after the final review invalidate the signed review before any transaction
Expiry during the final awaited wallet preflight is rechecked synchronously before wallet entry; zero send attempts
Unmounting the actual React root during the final awaited wallet check invalidates the review before wallet entry; zero send attempts
A safely consumed permit remains usable when the exact-price allowance already exists; no re-sign or extra approval transaction
Synchronous double clicks produce one signature and one transaction; a pending chain receipt stays unconfirmed without duplicate sends
Only a successful actual chain receipt confirms; a reverted permit purchase preserves its tracked hash without claiming an opening

flow.firstReview: Exact-price EIP-2612 signature only; no transaction or unsigned-open simulation.
flow.secondReview: The complete signed engine call is simulated and estimated, then explicit second confirmation sends one ordinary engine transaction.

failureCoverage: Unsupported old engine and unverified token domain offer a separately reviewed approval.
Rejected, malformed or wrong-wallet signatures never send or trigger fallback automatically.
Account/chain changes during signing refuse; nonce/expiry changes before send refuse unless an already-consumed permit left sufficient allowance.
Fresh VRF price beyond the signed ETH budget and post-sign ETH or PROTO shortage refuse.
Synchronous double clicks produce one signature and one transaction; pending and reverted chain receipts never claim confirmation.
Expiry during the final awaited wallet preflight refuses synchronously before wallet.sendTransaction; the actual wallet entry counter remains zero.
Unmounting the actual React root while the final wallet read is deferred clears the active review and preparation identity; releasing it produces zero wallet send entries.
limitations: Real signature recovery and sequential-call validation use synthetic local test accounts and mocked RPCs; no production wallet or provider is contacted.
The new permit entrypoint must be deployed and activated before this path becomes available. The known existing implementations retain the working separate-approval path.
Production deployment and live wallet/chain acceptance are separate owner actions.
The lifecycle guard prevents a future wallet request after unmount. It does not attempt to cancel a wallet RPC already invoked by an explicit confirmation.
